data.one_liner: Library to map file names or extensions to MIME types and vice versa
data.what_it_does: Provides three helper functions: mime, mimeFromExtension, and extensionFromMime. It is useful for setting Content-Type headers in HTTP servers and for determining file extensions from MIME types.
use_when: You need to set the correct Content-Type header when serving files over HTTP
You need to determine a file extension from a MIME type in a server or CLI tool
avoid_when: You need a full HTTP client or server framework; this package only handles MIME type mapping
You require advanced media type handling beyond simple mapping
strengths: Supports a wide range of MIME types, including recent additions like mjs and woff2
weaknesses: No support for content negotiation or media type parameters
Limited to MIME type mapping only

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a full HTTP client/server stack, including MIME type handling via its own utilities

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers advanced HTTP client features with built-in content-type handling
